# Ankhorage Local Infrastructure

![license: MIT](././paradox/badges/license.svg) ![npm: v0.3.36](././paradox/badges/npm.svg) ![runtime: bun](././paradox/badges/runtime.svg) ![typescript: strict](././paradox/badges/typescript.svg) ![eslint: checked](././paradox/badges/eslint.svg) ![prettier: checked](././paradox/badges/prettier.svg) ![build: checked](././paradox/badges/build.svg) ![tests: configured](././paradox/badges/tests.svg) ![paradox: canonical](././paradox/badges/docs.svg)

Provides a safe local-host compute adapter that reports the current Node host without mutating its lifecycle.

Expose the current machine through the provider-neutral compute boundary for local development and deterministic host inspection.

## Public API

### Utilities

<details>
<summary>createInfraAdapter</summary>

```ts
createInfraAdapter(options?: LocalComputeAdapterOptions) => InfraComputeAdapter<"local">
```

Create the canonical local-host compute adapter entrypoint.

The default adapter inspects the current Node host and never provisions, suspends or deletes the
user's machine. A probe can be injected for deterministic tests or another host environment.
